page.layout: One page of text in a single column. In the right margin, a note beside the first lines. Running head at the top centre, page number at the top right. Signature at the bottom left, catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: tò iterum fuere distracta, nuncvem di stractio nem. de nuò conjun-cta sunt tamen denuò conjuncta,
A. C. 1649. Causa fuit Bellum Ci-vile inter Regem & Parlamentum, ex quo bello tria sunt consequta:

3. Separatio Angliæ & Scotiæ; quarum illa titulum Reipublicæ assumsit: hæc Regem Carolum II suscepit; Sed eò paulò post armis Anglorum ejectò incertè fluctuavit usq; ad A. C. 1653 quò Generalis Olivarius Crom-welus publicis Comitiis Angliæ, Scotiæ & Hybernia Rerumpublicarum Protector salutatus est. Post hujus obitum Insularum dictarum incolæ A. C. 1660 & sequenti regiminis formam iterum mutarunt, & obtruncati Regis filium Carolum II ex Brabantia revocatum Regem constituerunt, qui adhuc hodie imperat.

page.notes: Right-margin note is set in small type across six short lines; transcribed as one note beside the first lines. The "cta" in "conjun-cta" in the note is read as a ct ligature and is doubtful. The faint text further right in the margin is show-through and left out. Long s is normalised to plain s throughout. The bottom signature "C 7" and catchword "HUN." are read from the scan. Sentence-initial "Sed" and "Post" follow the printed capitals.
